title: HoneyBook Alternatives 2026: Pricing and Plans Compared
h1: HoneyBook Alternatives 2026: Pricing, Plans and Limits Compared
metaDescription: Compare HoneyBook alternatives: Dubsado, 17hats, Bonsai, Moxie and FreshBooks, with published annual and monthly prices, team costs and limits.
intro:
Dubsado, 17hats, Bonsai, Moxie and FreshBooks are the five main HoneyBook alternatives for freelancer client management and invoicing.

Published monthly prices run from $9 per user on Bonsai Basic billed annually (no invoicing) to $109 on HoneyBook Premium billed annually, compared with HoneyBook Starter at $29 per month billed annually, and the billing basis of annual versus monthly changes every price on this page. 

[HoneyBook](https://www.honeybook.com/pricing) organizes client communication, proposals, contracts and billing into three tiers: Starter at $29 per month billed annually, Essentials at $49 per month billed annually and Premium at $109 per month billed annually. Paying month to month raises those rates to $36, $59 and $129 per month. Payment processing fees through HoneyBook start at 2.7% plus 10 cents per transaction for credit cards and 1.5% for Automated Clearing House (ACH) bank transfers.

Selecting a client management tool depends on team size, brand count and whether full accounting is needed alongside invoicing. For deeper context on financial tools, explore our [best accounting software for freelancers](/roundup/best-accounting-software-for-freelancers/) roundup and our [best business bank accounts roundup](/roundup/best-business-bank-accounts/). If double-entry ledgers are required, review our [QuickBooks alternatives](/alternatives/quickbooks/) guide or browse the [comparison hub](/compare/).

chooseSection.heading: How to Choose a HoneyBook Alternative
chooseSection.body:
Start with the billing interval, because commitment changes the annual outlay across all five HoneyBook alternatives. HoneyBook charges $29 per month on Starter when billed annually ($348 per year) versus $36 per month on monthly billing ($432 per year), an $84 annual difference. Dubsado quotes annual plans directly at $335 per year for Starter and $525 per year for Premier, noting that annual billing provides two months of savings. Moxie charges $10 per month billed annually ($120 per year) or $12 per month billed monthly ($144 per year) on Starter. 17hats offers three payment intervals: $60 per month billed monthly ($720 per year), $600 per year on annual billing, or $800 every two years ($400 per year equivalent). Calculate your total over a 12-month period rather than comparing monthly list figures.

Next, evaluate team member seat rules. HoneyBook Premium costs $109 per month billed annually ($1,308 per year) and includes unlimited team members. Dubsado includes three additional users for free on both plans, then charges $25 per month for 4 to 10 users, $45 per month for 11 to 20 users and $60 per month for 21 to 30 users. Bonsai prices strictly per user per month, charging $19 per user per month on Essentials billed annually or $29 on Premium, meaning software expenses multiply with every person added. FreshBooks charges an add-on fee of $11 per month for each additional team member. Moxie Teams covers up to five team members for $32 per month billed annually ($385 per year).

Then check document and client limits. HoneyBook Starter provides unlimited clients and projects, but caps lead forms at two live forms, while HoneyBook Essentials allows up to 10 live lead forms. Dubsado lists unlimited projects and clients on both Starter and Premier. In contrast, FreshBooks ties plan tiers to active client counts: Lite allows invoicing up to 5 clients and Plus up to 50 clients. 17hats restricts document volume depending on the tier, with caps of 20, 35 or unlimited documents per month.

Finally, separate software subscriptions from payment processing fees. HoneyBook charges card processing rates starting at 2.7% plus 10 cents per transaction and ACH bank transfer fees of 1.5%. HoneyBook notes that Premium subscribers transacting over $500,000 annually may qualify for discounted card fees. If you collect payments through external merchant accounts, verify whether your chosen alternative permits third-party payment gateways or requires embedded processing.

Review these checks before making a selection:

- How many team members require individual account logins?
- How many active clients and projects do you invoice each month?
- Do you need a built-in meeting scheduler or workflow automations?
- Are you paying annually to secure lower rates, or paying month to month for flexibility?
- Does your business require double-entry accounting and tax reports, or only invoicing and client contracts?

alternatives.heading: Dubsado Pricing, Plans and Fit
alternatives.body:
Dubsado provides client management software covering projects and clients. Dubsado sells two plans on an annual billing schedule: Starter Plan at $335 per year and Premier Plan at $525 per year. Dubsado states that choosing annual billing gives two months worth of savings compared to monthly payments. A 50% first-year discount through November 30 is advertised as a time-limited promotion. Both Dubsado plans include unlimited projects and clients. Dubsado offers a free trial to evaluate features before purchase.

Multi-brand management and extra team seats carry separate add-on charges. Dubsado charges $10 per month for each additional brand connected to an account. For team members, the first three additional users are free. Adding 4 to 10 users costs $25 per month, 11 to 20 users costs $45 per month, and 21 to 30 users costs $60 per month.

Dubsado fits solo freelancers and service businesses that handle multiple client projects and want unlimited clients without per-client subscription tiers.

Versus HoneyBook, Dubsado publishes annual pricing tables directly on its main pricing page, while HoneyBook offers both monthly and annual rates across Starter, Essentials and Premium. Dubsado charges $10 per month for each additional brand, whereas HoneyBook Premium includes multiple company profiles inside its $109 per month annual tier.

Worked example: A solo studio on Dubsado Starter pays $335 per year on annual billing. HoneyBook Starter costs $29 per month billed annually, which equals $348 per year. Dubsado Starter costs $13 less per year for a solo operator, though Dubsado Starter includes 1 active lead form and lacks scheduling, workflows and Zapier. If the business grows to five team members on Dubsado Premier, the annual cost is $525 for Premier plus $25 per month for the 4 to 10 user add-on ($300 per year), totaling $825 per year. The same five-person team on HoneyBook Premium pays $109 per month billed annually, or $1,308 per year, making Dubsado $483 cheaper annually for that five-person team.

alternatives.heading: 17hats Pricing, Plans and Fit
alternatives.body:
17hats offers business management software with document limits and scheduling add-ons. 17hats sells a single all-inclusive plan across three payment frequencies: $60 per month on monthly billing, $600 per year on annual billing (saving $120 compared with monthly), and $800 every two years on bi-yearly billing (saving $400 over two years). 17hats offers a 7-day free trial and a 30-day money-back guarantee. A promotional banner lists a 50% first-year offer for new customers.

17hats structures document usage and operational integrations through tiered limits and add-on fees. Document limits restrict accounts to 20, 35 or unlimited documents per month depending on the tier. Connecting a business bank feed costs an additional $5 per month. Online scheduling is sold as an add-on, costing $5 per month for basic scheduling or $10 per month for advanced scheduling on certain tiers.

17hats fits solo operators who prefer to lock in long-term savings through two-year software subscriptions.

Versus HoneyBook, 17hats separates bank feeds and online scheduling into paid monthly add-ons, whereas HoneyBook Essentials ($49 per month billed annually) bundles an online meeting scheduler into the base fee. HoneyBook Starter also provides unlimited proposals, contracts and invoices, while 17hats caps document output on lower tiers at 20 or 35 documents per month.

Worked example: On annual billing, 17hats costs $600 per year. Adding bank connect ($5 per month, or $60 per year) and basic scheduling ($5 per month, or $60 per year) brings the annual total to $720. HoneyBook Essentials costs $49 per month billed annually, which equals $588 per year with scheduling included, saving $132 per year compared with 17hats with those add-ons. On monthly billing without add-ons, 17hats costs $60 multiplied by 12, or $720 per year, compared with $432 per year on HoneyBook Starter billed monthly ($36 multiplied by 12).

alternatives.heading: Bonsai Pricing, Plans and Fit
alternatives.body:
Bonsai provides business operations, proposals, contracts and client billing software priced on a per-user basis. Billed annually, Bonsai offers four plans: Basic at $9 per user per month, Essentials at $19 per user per month, Premium at $29 per user per month, and Elite at $49 per user per month (with a mandatory 3-user minimum). On monthly billing, Basic costs $15 per user per month. Bonsai offers a free start option to test features.

Feature access expands by tier. Invoicing, online payments, proposals, contracts, scheduling, client portal access, and expense tracking begin at the Essentials tier ($19 per user per month billed annually). Premium ($29 per user per month billed annually) adds project insights, workload management, a Gantt chart view, and integrations with QuickBooks, Xero, and Zapier. Elite ($49 per user per month billed annually) introduces custom user permissions.

Bonsai fits independent freelancers and boutique agencies that want contracts, proposals and scheduling tied to individual user seats.

Versus HoneyBook, Bonsai scales its subscription cost with every added user seat, whereas HoneyBook Premium ($109 per month billed annually) includes unlimited team members for a flat fee. For single-person businesses needing contract templates and invoicing, Bonsai Essentials provides an entry plan at $19 per month billed annually, which is $10 per month lower than HoneyBook Starter.

Worked example: A solo freelancer using Bonsai Essentials pays $19 per month billed annually, totaling $228 per year. HoneyBook Starter costs $29 per month billed annually, or $348 per year. For a solo operator, Bonsai Essentials costs $120 less per year. However, for a team of four users on Bonsai Essentials, the annual cost is 4 multiplied by $19 multiplied by 12, which equals $912 per year. On Bonsai Premium, four users cost 4 multiplied by $29 multiplied by 12, which equals $1,392 per year. HoneyBook Premium costs $1,308 per year ($109 per month billed annually) with unlimited team seats, making HoneyBook $84 cheaper annually than Bonsai Premium for a four-person team.

alternatives.heading: Moxie Pricing, Plans and Fit
alternatives.body:
Moxie is a freelance management platform that bundles client management, project management, proposals and invoicing. Moxie publishes three subscription tiers. Starter costs $10 per month billed annually ($120 charged annually) or $12 per month billed monthly. Pro costs $20 per month billed annually ($240 charged annually) or $25 per month billed monthly. Teams costs $32 per month billed annually ($385 charged annually) or $40 per month billed monthly. Teams covers up to five team members. Moxie provides a 14-day free trial on all plans.

Moxie includes client management, project management, invoicing, online payments, proposals, time tracking, and a sales pipeline across its product tiers. 

Moxie fits budget-conscious solo freelancers and small teams of up to five people seeking project management, time tracking, and invoicing at low annual rates.

Versus HoneyBook, Moxie Starter costs $10 per month billed annually ($120 per year), which is $228 per year less than HoneyBook Starter at $29 per month billed annually ($348 per year). HoneyBook lists HoneyBook AI on Starter, while Moxie lists a Moxie AI assistant on Starter. Moxie Teams caps membership at five users, whereas HoneyBook Premium supports unlimited team members.

Worked example: A solo freelancer on Moxie Starter pays $120 per year on annual billing ($10 per month). HoneyBook Starter costs $348 per year on annual billing ($29 per month). Choosing Moxie Starter saves that solo freelancer $228 per year. On monthly billing, Moxie Starter costs $12 multiplied by 12, or $144 per year, compared with $432 per year on HoneyBook Starter ($36 multiplied by 12), saving $288 annually. For a five-person business, Moxie Teams costs $385 per year billed annually, while HoneyBook Premium costs $1,308 per year billed annually, a difference of $923 per year.

alternatives.heading: FreshBooks Pricing, Plans and Fit
alternatives.body:
FreshBooks is an accounting and invoicing software platform that organizes pricing by active billable client count. FreshBooks publishes monthly list prices: Lite at $23.00 per month for up to 5 billable clients; Plus at $43.00 per month for up to 50 clients; and Premium at $70.00 per month. FreshBooks also offers a quote-based Select tier. A promotional Black Friday offer advertises 90% off for 4 months (discounting Lite to $2.30, Plus to $4.30, and Premium to $7.00 per month during that four-month window). FreshBooks includes a 30-day money-back guarantee.

Additional business features require paid add-ons. Adding team members costs $11 per user per month. Advanced Payments costs $20 per month. FreshBooks Payroll costs $40 per month plus $6 per user per month. FreshBooks Lite invoices up to 5 clients, Plus invoices up to 50 clients, and Premium adds project profitability tracking.

FreshBooks fits service providers and independent contractors who need invoicing and project profitability tracking structured by client count.

Versus HoneyBook, FreshBooks restricts client numbers on its lower tiers, capping Lite at 5 clients and Plus at 50 clients. HoneyBook Starter ($29 per month billed annually) includes unlimited clients and projects, along with proposals, contracts and a client portal. FreshBooks provides project profitability tracking, whereas HoneyBook integrates with QuickBooks Online.

Worked example: A freelancer invoicing 25 clients per month requires FreshBooks Plus, which costs $43 per month, or $516 per year at regular list prices. HoneyBook Starter covers unlimited clients for $29 per month billed annually, which equals $348 per year. HoneyBook Starter saves that freelancer $168 per year compared with FreshBooks Plus. If the business has 60 clients, FreshBooks Premium costs $70 per month, or $840 per year, compared with $588 per year for HoneyBook Essentials ($49 per month billed annually), a savings of $252 per year on HoneyBook.

alternatives.heading: Who This Is Not For
alternatives.body:
This comparison evaluates published prices, team limits and software tiers for freelancer client management. It does not fit every business situation.

- Businesses requiring physical inventory tracking, warehouse logistics, or retail point-of-sale hardware. 
- Companies needing dedicated enterprise payroll and human resources management. FreshBooks offers a payroll add-on for $40 per month plus $6 per user.
- Professionals seeking a free software tier with zero ongoing costs. None of the six providers in this comparison publishes a permanently free plan, though Bonsai offers a free start option.
- Businesses that require double-entry general ledgers and balance sheet reporting natively inside their client tool. HoneyBook Essentials includes an integration with QuickBooks Online.

alternatives.heading: What Would Change Our Answer on HoneyBook Alternatives
alternatives.body:
The comparisons on this page reflect published rates, terms and promotional disclosures checked on November 26, 2026. Several vendor changes would shift the financial comparisons:

- HoneyBook adjusting its $29 Starter, $49 Essentials or $109 Premium annual rates, or altering its 2.7% plus 10 cents card transaction fee.
- Dubsado altering its annual pricing or changing its three-free-user allowance.
- FreshBooks eliminating the 5-client and 50-client limits on its Lite and Plus tiers, which would allow high-volume invoicing at lower price points.
- Moxie modifying its $120 annual Starter price or increasing its five-member seat limit on Teams.
- 17hats including bank feeds or online scheduling directly inside its $600 annual base subscription rather than charging monthly add-on fees.
- Bonsai altering its $19 Essentials or $29 Premium per-user seat fees.

Recalculate annual expenses whenever vendor rates change.

stillBetterFit.heading: When HoneyBook Is Still the Better Fit
stillBetterFit.body:
HoneyBook remains the closer match for freelancers who want unlimited client projects, proposals, contracts and digital payments managed in one platform without tracking client caps.

HoneyBook Starter costs $29 per month billed annually ($348 per year) or $36 per month billed monthly ($432 per year). It includes unlimited clients and projects, invoices and payments, proposals and contracts, calendar, client portal, basic reporting, up to two live lead forms, and proprietary HoneyBook AI tools. In contrast, FreshBooks Lite ($23 per month) restricts users to 5 clients, and 17hats limits lower tiers to 20 or 35 documents per month.

For growing businesses requiring team workflows, HoneyBook Essentials costs $49 per month billed annually ($588 per year) or $59 per month billed monthly ($708 per year). Essentials adds a meeting scheduler, workflow automations, QuickBooks Online integration, up to 10 live lead forms, Short Message Service (SMS) client reminders, standard financial reports and removal of the 'Powered by HoneyBook' badge. 17hats charges add-on fees for scheduling and bank connections, whereas HoneyBook Essentials includes scheduling and integrations in its base price.

For multi-user teams and multi-brand businesses, HoneyBook Premium costs $109 per month billed annually ($1,308 per year) or $129 per month billed monthly ($1,548 per year). Premium includes unlimited team members, priority customer support, management of multiple companies, and advanced reports. On Bonsai, adding team members multiplies monthly per-user costs, making a four-person team on Bonsai Premium cost $1,392 per year billed annually, which exceeds HoneyBook Premium.

Payment processing through HoneyBook starts at 2.7% plus 10 cents per card transaction, and ACH bank transfers cost 1.5%. HoneyBook notes that Premium subscribers transacting more than $500,000 annually may be eligible for custom discounted card rates. All HoneyBook plans begin with a free trial and allow users to change or cancel subscriptions at any time.

verdict:
Moxie Starter costs $10 per month billed annually ($120 per year), Bonsai provides per-user modular tools starting at $19 per user per month on Essentials, and Dubsado supports unlimited clients for $335 per year on Starter. FreshBooks ties pricing to active client volume starting at $23 per month for five clients, and 17hats offers an all-inclusive single plan for $600 per year. HoneyBook provides unlimited clients and projects across all tiers, with Starter at $29 per month billed annually and Premium covering unlimited team members for $109 per month billed annually.

To pick a HoneyBook alternative, write down your active monthly client count, count the team members who need system logins, determine whether meeting scheduling is required, and compare the matching annual plan totals in the table above.

faqs.question: What should I use instead of HoneyBook?
faqs.answer: Dubsado, 17hats, Bonsai, Moxie and FreshBooks are the five main HoneyBook alternatives. Dubsado fits unlimited client projects with annual pricing, Moxie fits budget-conscious solo freelancers from $10 per month billed annually, Bonsai fits users who want per-seat pricing, 17hats offers multi-year payment terms, and FreshBooks structures pricing by billable client tiers.

faqs.question: Which HoneyBook alternative is the cheapest?
faqs.answer: Bonsai Basic starts at $9 per user per month billed annually without invoicing, while Moxie Starter costs $10 per month billed annually ($120 per year) or $12 per month billed monthly. HoneyBook Starter costs $29 per month billed annually ($348 per year) or $36 per month billed monthly.

faqs.question: Does Dubsado cost less than HoneyBook?
faqs.answer: Dubsado Starter costs $335 per year on annual billing, which is $13 less than HoneyBook Starter at $348 per year ($29 per month billed annually). However, HoneyBook Essentials costs $588 per year ($49 per month billed annually), while Dubsado Premier costs $525 per year. Team add-ons on Dubsado cost $25 per month for 4 to 10 users, whereas HoneyBook Premium includes unlimited team members for $109 per month billed annually.

faqs.question: Which HoneyBook alternatives include unlimited clients?
faqs.answer: Dubsado includes unlimited projects and clients on both Starter ($335 per year) and Premier ($525 per year). HoneyBook includes unlimited clients and projects across all plans. In contrast, FreshBooks caps Lite at 5 clients and Plus at 50 clients, while Premium ($70 per month) adds project profitability.

faqs.question: What does HoneyBook charge for payment processing?
faqs.answer: HoneyBook charges card processing fees starting at 2.7% plus 10 cents per transaction. Bank transfers via ACH cost 1.5%. HoneyBook states that Premium plan members who process over $500,000 annually may qualify for discounted card processing rates.
